combo_label: Jobs & Professions × Musical Instruments × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Wires stems into a bridal bouquet and ties the ribbon on a wreath
Little Miss so small she lives in a mousehole at Home Farm; minute indeed
Slides under the car to drain the oil and swap the worn brake pads
Broad rosewood bars over long tubes, mellower and deeper than the xylophone
Black cylinder of woodwind, flared at the bell, warm and woody down low
Saws and planes timber on site, framing stud walls and raising roof trusses
Church behemoth of stacked keyboards, foot pedals and wind-blown ranks
Blue Hargreaves chap wrapped head to toe in bandages; a knock or a sudden jolt
Yellow Hargreaves chap shaped like a rubber ball; to spring back off the floor
Shallow drum with rattling wires beneath, giving a marching beat its crack
Roger Hargreaves' orange chap with impossibly long arms; what a feather does
